HOLY F*CK. her agents find a bug, fix it and ship it before anyone on the team wakes up

SpaceXAI engineer Lauren Tan:

"most people still check every line their agent writes by hand. that's why they'll never ship 4,000 updates a month"

37-minute talk. she shows how she got her agents to run their own code like a real user and check their own work

Agent Writes It - Uses It Like A Real User - Finds Its Own Bugs - Fixes Them - Merges It Itself

a user reports something small at night. by morning it's fixed and live. nobody touched it

better than any $5,000 coding bootcamp

skip netflix, watch it tonight, then tell me - how many lines did you check by hand today?
